text_verbatim:
(1) Where a Data Fiduciary becomes aware of a personal data breach, it shall intimate the Board without delay,
providing an initial description of the breach, including the nature, extent, and timing of the incident.

trigger.description: Data Fiduciary becomes aware of a personal data breach

normalized.action: Intimate the Data Protection Board of India without delay, providing an initial description of the personal data breach including nature, extent, and timing.

citations.excerpt_verbatim:
(1) Where a Data Fiduciary becomes aware of a personal data breach, it shall intimate the Board without delay,
providing an initial description of the breach, including the nature, extent, and timing of the incident.

confidence_reason: Verbatim text from Gazette notification. In force from 13 May 2027 under Rule 1(2)(c) 18-month commencement.

text_verbatim:
(2) The Data Fiduciary shall submit a detailed report to the Board within 72 hours of becoming aware of the
personal data breach, containing the root cause analysis, remedial actions taken or proposed to be taken, and
the status of intimation to data principals.

trigger.description: Data Fiduciary becomes aware of a personal data breach

normalized.action: Submit a detailed personal data breach report to the Data Protection Board of India within 72 hours of becoming aware.

text_verbatim:
(3) The Data Fiduciary shall also intimate each affected Data Principal without delay regarding the personal
data breach, describing the nature of the breach, likely consequences, and safety measures recommended to
be taken.

trigger.description: Personal data breach affecting Data Principals

normalized.action: Intimate each affected Data Principal without delay regarding the personal data breach in plain language.
evidence_required: copies of intimation sent to data principals
